diagnosis: The checks C1, C3, and C5 passed without the hidden information because the lone decision-maker used default values and thresholds that were easy to hit. Specifically, check C1 and C3 both passed due to the default 'true' value for the crane removal and spotter requirement, respectively. Check C5 passed because the default exclusion zone was 5 meters, which matched the settlement's 5 meters exactly.

C1.why: The measured 18% brake lining changes the crane status to removed from service, fixes the repair duration at exactly 6 hours, and requires a 125% proof-load test and brake-replacement commitment.

C3.why: The measured 18% brake lining changes the crane status to removed from service, fixes the repair duration at exactly 6 hours, and requires a 125% proof-load test and brake-replacement commitment.

C5.why: The blocked forklift route changes the alternative-lift decision to prohibited, fixes the exclusion zone at 10 meters, requires a designated spotter, and requires a bay-exclusion control commitment.
